data.rationale: The proposal follows the same caniuse → MDN → mail draft sequence with the right parameters (customer split into recipient_email and recipient_name), but it is vague on how to handle "unsupported", on using the Mail tab and a new MDN tab, on typing the customer email as {customer}@example.com, and on the final step ("Send (or discard...)"), which risks sending when the true workflow says to Discard and close the MDN tab. It also uses inconsistent placeholders ({name}, {version}, {mdn_url}).
